Do not read original session paths, temporary workspace paths, unlisted files or the interrupted grader's files.

Before grading subject matter, read the manifest, protocol/evals-README.md, the Execution and evidence protocol section in protocol/implementation.md, and capture-format.md. Then inspect frozen canonical instructions, every eval.json and oracle.json where present, before/after artifacts and source fixtures, editor/reader answers, complete visible tool/message records, prompts, manifests, settings, snapshots, hashes and dispatch receipts. Treat coordinator integrity/access conclusions as claims to verify.

Grade every one of the 40 assertions independently as PASS, FAIL or PARTIAL with concrete evidence; do not weaken assertions. Cases 1–6 require original/revised reader judgments on the five fixed questions, with comprehension separated from fidelity, source inspection, orientation and correctness. A factual defect still requires repair when the five reader answers already pass; a clear accurate baseline must remain unchanged. Cases 7–10 grade routing, actual tool use and file effects; reader comparison is N/A. Check exact natural request preservation and description-only selection for non-trigger cases without body preloading or rejection priming.

Audit all participant reads/writes against manifests, instruction-before-source order, file effects, equal reader questions/model/settings, trace coverage and output truncation. The three per-participant JSONL exports are intentionally equivalent: they retain complete visible assistant messages, inbound task messages, tool calls and results with original ordinals, while excluding harness setup and hidden reasoning. Original session hashes and deterministic-filter coverage are recorded separately. The first grader was interrupted when this packaging correction was required; do not use its conclusions. Source artifacts, participant answers, prompts and all 141 editor/reader visible records were preserved. Verify the published records rather than requiring excluded privileged content. Encrypted dispatch remains a transport limitation when exact pre-dispatch plaintext and receipt linkage exist; missing, reconstructed or mismatched required records invalidate a run. The first seven participants have pre-dispatch plaintext files; later participants also have exact JSON message envelopes.

A coordinator-only read hook rejection is preserved in protocol/coordinator-hook-rejection.json. It did not occur during editor/reader execution. Judge from the complete captured visible sources, and identify anything genuinely unverifiable. Keep output bounded; if a tool output truncates, reread omitted material and record coverage.

Save verdicts.json with scenario_results (id/name, all assertion ids/verdicts/evidence, original/revised question judgments or N/A, and access/evidence-integrity verdict), totals, limitations and inspected-file/record coverage. Cite paths relative to documents/ with useful line numbers or native ordinals. Finish with concise counts and unresolved issues.
